caption: The drawing consists of a single, round, lidded container shown in three-quarter view, rendered in graphite pencil on a beige or off-white background. The container appears to be metallic or polished, as indicated by the smooth, shaded surface and highlights. On the top of the lid, there is an elaborate monogram with ornate, intertwined letters inside a circular decorative border. The sides of the container are slightly tapered with horizontal bands at the top and bottom edges. In the lower left corner of the drawing, there is a smaller inset showing the side view of the container with measurements indicated by double-headed arrows; the inset is labeled "ACTUAL SIZE" and drawn in simple lines with less shading. The main drawing is framed by a single-line rectangular border, while the rest of the background is blank. The colors in the drawing are limited to shades of gray and the natural color of the paper.
title: Silver Box
